data_categories: account and organization data (email, sign-in and security records, audit log)
application source code, build artifacts and container images
application environment variables and secrets (secrets sealed with host keys before storage)
application request logs and metrics
managed Postgres databases and object storage contents
backups of the above
sub_processors.encryption: TLS in transit; customer secrets sealed at rest with host keys

data_categories: account and organization data (email, sign-in and security records, audit log)

sub_processors.service: DNS, reverse proxy and TLS termination, CDN and DDoS / web application firewall protection
data_categories: request metadata for traffic to Gregale and customer apps (IP address, headers, URL, timing)
request and response bodies in transit through the proxy
DNS records for Gregale and customer custom domains
sub_processors.encryption: TLS in transit at the edge and to origin
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Cloudflare Customer Data Processing Addendum (linked from the Cloudflare dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Every request to gregale.dev, the API and customer apps passes through Cloudflare for DNS, TLS, caching and attack protection before it reaches Gregale's servers.

sub_processors.service: Polar merchant of record + usage-based billing
data_categories: customer email
plan tier
metered usage (account-id + hours + GB-RAM-hours)
invoice and subscription metadata
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Polar Data Processing Addendum (linked from Polar organization dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Public-release merchant of record. Gregale sends customer email, plan, subscription metadata, and calendar-month net overage events; Polar handles payment data and applicable merchant-of-record tax obligations under its merchant-of-record model.

sub_processors.service: Resend transactional email transport + Svix-signed webhook (bounce / complaint / delivery events)
data_categories: recipient email (account holder only)
subject + body of the transactional message
inbound bounce / complaint events: recipient email + bounce reason + provider event id
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Resend Data Processing Addendum (linked from Resend Dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Transactional email transport + inbound webhook. Outbound: account-holder-only email (no end-user PII). Inbound (issue #246 / ADR-115 §D.3): Resend POSTs bounce / complaint / delivery events to /v1/webhooks/resend, Svix HMAC-signed; payload carries recipient email + provider event id, no body or subject. The bounce handler (pkg/meter/bounce_handler.go) writes a mail_suppressions row + a mail.bounce_hard / mail.bounce_complaint audit row + advances dunning for hard bounces. Default in dev is 'log' (writes to slog; no third-party processing).

data_categories: OAuth subject (sub)
verified email address
optional profile name and avatar URL
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Google Cloud Data Processing Addendum (linked from Google Cloud Console)
sub_processors.rationale: Account holders who choose Google login exchange the OAuth subject and a verified email — and the optional profile name and avatar URL — at POST /v1/auth/google/callback. No contact list, no Drive, no repo list. Scopes are openid email profile.

data_categories: GitHub user-id
primary verified email address
login handle
optional name and avatar URL
sub_processors.dpa_reference: GitHub Data Protection Addendum (linked from GitHub Settings)
sub_processors.rationale: Account holders who choose GitHub login exchange the GitHub user-id, primary verified email, and login handle — and the optional name and avatar URL — at POST /v1/auth/github/callback. No repo list, no contact list, no org list. Scopes are read:user user:email.

sub_processors.service: GitHub App: repository access for deploys, Checks API and install-token exchange (outbound from githubd)
data_categories: source archives of repositories the customer connects, fetched to build deployments
commit metadata (SHA, branch, author) for deploys and Checks
OAuth install-token exchange payloads
sub_processors.dpa_reference: GitHub Data Protection Addendum (linked from GitHub Settings)
sub_processors.rationale: githubd is the only outbound caller to api.github.com. It fetches the source of repositories a customer connects through the Gregale GitHub App to build their deployments, posts Checks results keyed by commit SHA, and exchanges installation tokens. Inbound webhooks at POST /webhooks/github are HMAC-SHA-256 verified (X-Hub-Signature-256, constant-time compare) before any payload is consumed.

sub_processors.service: Hosting for the gregale.dev website, documentation and web front end
data_categories: website visitor request metadata (IP address, user agent, URL) in request logs
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Vercel Data Processing Addendum (linked from the Vercel dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Serves the marketing site, docs and web front end. Account data and applications are stored by Gregale's own servers, not Vercel.
